name: How long does the custom cabinetry design and installation process typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the custom cabinetry design and installation process typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for custom cabinetry varies based on the project's complexity, size, and chosen materials. Generally, the design phase can take several weeks, followed by fabrication, which typically ranges from 8 to 16 weeks. Installation usually takes 1 to 2 weeks, depending on the scope. We provide a detailed project schedule early in the process to keep you informed every step of the way, ensuring efficient execution without compromising on quality for your luxury home.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process typically involves a few weeks for design, 8-16 weeks for fabrication, and 1-2 weeks for installation, depending on complexity.
